description: Map the five principal single-strand interruptions of T5 DNA onto the annotated genome and measure their distance to late (virion/morphogenesis) genes
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
gb=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi", params={"db":"nuccore","id":"AY587007.1","rettype":"gb","retmode":"text"}, timeout=120).text
GL=121752
feats=re.split(r"\n(?=     (?:CDS|gene)  )", gb[gb.index("FEATURES"):gb.index("\nORIGIN")])
rows=[]
for f in feats:
    s=f.strip()
    if not s.startswith("CDS"): continue
    loc=re.match(r"CDS\s+(\S+)",s).group(1); nums=[int(x) for x in re.findall(r"\d+",loc)]
    if not nums: continue
    def q(n):
        m=re.search(r'/%s="([^"]*)"'%n,f,re.S); return re.sub(r"\s+"," ",m.group(1)) if m else ""
    rows.append(dict(start=min(nums),end=max(nums),strand="-" if "complement" in loc else "+",
                     gene=q("gene"),prod=q("product")))
cds=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("start").reset_index(drop=True)
cds["pct_start"]=100*np.where(cds.strand=="+",cds.start,cds.end)/GL   # transcription start end of ORF

# Classify morphogenesis / virion-structural genes (late class in T5) from product annotation
LATE_KW = r"capsid|portal|terminase|tail|head|scaffold|baseplate|fib(re|er)|lys(in|ozyme)|holin|major|minor (tail|capsid)|neck|collar|protease.*(head|capsid)|decoration|receptor.binding"
cds["late_struct"]=cds["prod"].str.contains(LATE_KW, case=False, regex=True, na=False)
late=cds[cds.late_struct]
print("structural/morphogenesis (late-class) CDS:", len(late))
print("their genome span: %.1f%% - %.1f%%  (median %.1f%%)" % (late.pct_start.min(), late.pct_start.max(), late.pct_start.median()))
q10,q90=np.percentile(late.pct_start,[10,90]); print("10-90%% interval of late-gene starts: %.1f%% - %.1f%%" % (q10,q90))

# Principal single-strand interruptions (Scheible & Rhoades 1977 PMID 330881; Rhoades 1982 PMID 6287031; Mikoulinskaia 2004 PMID 14711503)
nicks = {"nick 7.9%":7.9, "nick 18.5%":18.5, "nick 32.6%":32.6, "nick 64.8%":64.8, "nick 99.6%":99.6}
print("\n=== distance from each principal interruption to the nearest late-class (structural) gene start ===")
res=[]
for k,v in nicks.items():
    d=np.abs(late.pct_start.values-v)
    j=d.argmin()
    res.append(dict(interruption=k, pct=v, bp=int(v/100*GL),
                    nearest_late_gene_start_pct=round(late.pct_start.values[j],2),
                    distance_pct=round(d[j],2), distance_kb=round(d[j]/100*GL/1000,1),
                    nearest_product=late["prod"].values[j][:45]))
R=pd.DataFrame(res); pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",50)
print(R.to_string(index=False))
print("\nD15 (exo5) itself at 65.9-66.6%% of the genome; nick 64.8%% lies %.1f kb to its left." % ((66.2-64.8)/100*GL/1000))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,3.4))
ax.hlines(0,0,100,color="0.75",lw=3)
ax.plot(cds[~cds.late_struct].pct_start,[0.25]*(~cds.late_struct).sum(),"|",color="#4C78A8",ms=9,label="other CDS (n=%d)"%(~cds.late_struct).sum())
ax.plot(late.pct_start,[-0.25]*len(late),"|",color="#E45756",ms=11,label="virion/morphogenesis CDS (late class, n=%d)"%len(late))
for k,v in nicks.items():
    ax.axvline(v,color="#54A24B",ls="--",lw=1.6)
    ax.text(v,0.72,k.replace("nick ",""),ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#54A24B")
ax.axvline(66.2,color="black",lw=2); ax.text(66.2,-0.78,"D15",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(0,100); ax.set_ylim(-1,1); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("position on T5 genome AY587007 (% of 121,752 bp)")
ax.set_title("Principal single-strand interruptions of T5 DNA against the late (virion) gene cluster")
ax.legend(loc="upper left",fontsize=8,frameon=False)
for sp in ["left","right","top"]: ax.spines[sp].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
